V16 Piston Animal features an in-line compressing bin and dual conical cleaner head, contradicting target's perpendicular bin and radial cyclone body.
WashG1 is a dedicated wet floor cleaner with dual counter-rotating microfibre rollers and water tanks, contradicting this dry cyclone vacuum.
V11 uses an in-line dust bin and rear display, contradicting target's perpendicular bin positioned below the cyclones.
Gen5detect features an in-line bin layout and single-button power control, contradicting target's perpendicular bin and top lift lever.
Shark Stratos uses an elongated dark horizontal handheld body with Shark branding, contradicting target's Dyson radial cyclone body and branding.
